{{Top|leg}}
The '''Melchett clan''' was one of the seven major clans of [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. It was named for the ''[[Melchett]]'', one of the original [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] which brought [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to Ammuud.
